scope: Reconcile current independent DXF/DWG reader, writer, and consumer evidence with existing safety, carrier, and version gates; correct stale 7BE status without duplicating findings.

method.kind: Primary project documentation/release review, issue-report review, and local plan/receipt reconciliation
method.peerRevisionPinning: Release tag pinned where available; issue reports are mutable peer observations.
localInspection: Existing GDAL comparator scope already distinguishes Binary-DXF read, raw ASM/transform extraction, and direct binary-to-ASCII conversion.
Local repeated-record stress controls for comments, XDATA application blocks, and WIPEOUT boundaries are already recorded as passing.
7BE.8 already contains generated AC1018/1021/1024/1027/1032 logical-envelope and maintenance profiles plus AC1012/1014 envelope-only controls.
Fresh tracked AC1032 CLI read succeeds but export preflight currently stops later at typed VISUALSTYLE carrier coverage.
7BP/PAR-119 currently keeps ODA v5.4.1 section 20.4.78 authoritative and records LibreDWG/ACadSharp disagreement as non-promoting peer evidence.
method.limitations: Peer issue reports and release notes do not prove matching local defects or normative behavior. No peer runtime, producer artifact, native application, or semantic ACIS/ACDS evidence was produced.

evidence.topic: GDAL Binary DXF and 3D projection boundary
evidence.observed: Stable GDAL docs state Binary DXF reading starts with 3.12. Its DXF reader produces OGR features, raw unknown groups are opt-in, and AC1027+ 3D extensibility exposes raw ASM bytes plus a 12-value transform rather than a solid B-rep.
evidence.planUse: Retain the existing optional composed comparator with pinned version/options and manifest comparison; do not add per-slice peer work or promote carrier/projection results to 3D semantics.

evidence.observed: NEWS describes capacity/logical-size divergence, invalid offsets and size arithmetic, pointer invalidation across reallocation, SAT size overflow, no-progress loops, non-finite angle loops, HATCH per-path handle loss, binary TF chunk handling, and a dropped final SAT block.
evidence.planUse: Reuse existing PAR-14/PAR-26/7S/7BE/7BA/7F owners and boundary-specific invariants; do not transfer peer limits or create duplicate tests unless a touched local path lacks a corresponding control.

evidence.observed: The signed v3.8.0 release is at 3a1c66b. Issue #1281 reports repeated-record stack exhaustion; #1279 gives a missing-VERTEX-subtype case; #1261 reports a private-drawing GeoData object-tail disagreement. #1282/#1283 were available only as issue-index titles in this pass.
evidence.planUse: Reuse the local repeated-record test, retain malformed POLYLINE disposition under 7BS, retain GeoData under ODA-governed PAR-119/7BP, and make no new peer-specific rule from inaccessible issue details.

evidence.observed: The plan and 7BE.8 receipt already document generated modern maintenance/envelope profiles and AC1012/AC1014 envelope-only controls; the former wording incorrectly called them absent.
evidence.planUse: Mark generated profiles present; leave real-producer per-lineage witnesses, full R13/R14 section/body-path behavior, scheduled sanitizer conditions, and downstream VISUALSTYLE serialization as separate open gates.
